ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב הִגִּיעַ לְמָקוֹם זָר וְחִפֵּשׂ אֲנָשִׁים שֶׁיּוּכְלוּ לַעֲזֹר לוֹ.
ideas.children_en: Jacob felt safe because he believed someone was with him. He came near a well with sheep and shepherds who needed to roll away a big stone to get water from the well.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב פָּגַשׁ אֶת רָחֵל וְעָזַר לָהּ לְהַשְׁקוֹת אֶת הַצֹּאן.
ideas.children_en: Jacob asked the shepherds where they lived and about Laban, Rachel's father. When Rachel came, Jacob lifted the big stone alone to give water to the sheep.

ideas.children_he: פְּגִישָׁה מְשַׂמַּחַת עִם מִשְׁפָּחָה יְכוֹלָה לָתֵת תְּחוּשָׁה שֶׁל בַּיִת.
ideas.children_en: Jacob met Rachel and was very happy. He told her he was family. Rachel told her father. Laban welcomed Jacob and Jacob stayed and helped him for a month.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב אָהַב אֶת רָחֵל וְהָיָה מוּכָן לַעֲבֹד שֶׁבַע שָׁנִים כְּדֵי לְהִנָּשֵׂא לָהּ.
ideas.children_en: Laban told Jacob to say his wages. Jacob loved Rachel and worked for seven years for her. Laban agreed to give Rachel only to Jacob.

ideas.children_he: לָבָן הִטְעָה אֶת יַעֲקֹב וְהֵבִיא לוֹ אֶת לֵאָה בִּמְקוֹם רָחֵל.
ideas.children_en: After seven years, Jacob asked to marry Rachel. Laban made a wedding party but gave Leah, the older sister, not Rachel at night. Jacob did not know.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב גִּלָּה שֶׁהוּטְעָה. שֶׁקֶר יָכוֹל לִפְגֹּעַ בְּאֵמוּן.
ideas.children_en: Jacob saw in the morning that his wife was Leah and asked why Laban tricked him. Laban said the older sister must marry first, then Rachel later after seven more years.

ideas.children_he: יַעֲקֹב נָשָׂא גַּם אֶת רָחֵל, אֲבָל הַיַּחַס הַשּׁוֹנֶה לַאֲחָיוֹת יָצַר כְּאֵב.
ideas.children_en: Jacob worked hard and also got Rachel after Leah's wedding week. Laban gave Rachel a servant, Bilhah. Jacob loved Rachel more, even though she came later.

ideas.children_he: לֵאָה הִרְגִּישָׁה פָּחוֹת אֲהוּבָה. כָּל אָדָם רוֹצֶה לְהַרְגִּישׁ רָצוּי.
ideas.children_en: God saw Leah was less loved than Rachel and helped her have children. Rachel was unable to have children. This difference was clear as Leah had many kids first.

ideas.children_he: לֵאָה קִוְּתָה שֶׁלֵּדַת רְאוּבֵן תְּקָרֵב אֵלֶיהָ אֶת יַעֲקֹב.
ideas.children_en: Leah had her first son and called him Reuben because she believed God saw her suffering and Jacob would love her more as his son's mother.

ideas.children_he: גַּם אַחֲרֵי לֵדַת שִׁמְעוֹן לֵאָה הִמְשִׁיכָה לְחַפֵּשׂ אַהֲבָה.
ideas.children_en: Leah had a second son and named him Simeon because she felt still unloved, and having a child did not change Jacob's feeling toward her.

ideas.children_he: לֵאָה קִוְּתָה שֶׁבְּנֵי הַמִּשְׁפָּחָה יִתְקָרְבוּ זֶה לָזֶה.
ideas.children_en: Leah had a third son hoping Jacob would love her more with three sons. Jacob was happy with the new son as part of his family growing.

ideas.children_he: בְּלֵדַת יְהוּדָה לֵאָה בָּחֲרָה לְהוֹדוֹת עַל הַטּוֹב שֶׁיֵּשׁ לָהּ.
ideas.children_en: Leah had a fourth son named Judah because she thanked God for the happiness of having children. Then she stopped having children for a while.
